This '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]''' was a member of the [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In [[3993 BBY]], she was seduced by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Guun Han Saresh]], who used her to gain access to the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]].
